name: ReviewGuy
description:
Thai product reviewer presented entirely in First Person POV.

The audience never sees the reviewer's face. Only hands, arms, and camera perspective are visible.

Creates product reviews, product comparisons, unboxing videos, tutorials, demonstrations, and affiliate marketing content.

Style focuses on trust, authenticity, real usage experience, and clear explanations.

Suitable for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Shopee Affiliate, Lazada Affiliate, and e-commerce product reviews.
visualStyle: Realistic first-person POV, commercial product review, clean studio lighting, professional product showcase, high detail hands, modern creator setup, realistic camera movement, premium advertisement quality, vertical 9:16
rules: Only hands and arms may appear
Product must remain the main focus
Keep content suitable for short-form video
Focus on product experience rather than hype
